Lead-lag

Each point is the correlation, over the window, of the leader's last 500 ms return at a decision with the follower's 500 ms return ending a lag later. A follower that copies the leader with a delay peaks at that delay; a peak left of zero means the follower moved first, and a curve symmetric about zero is two prices moving together. The shaded strip is the 100 ms from the decision to a taker's fill: a follower move that ends inside it is over before the order lands. The dotted line is the follower's first whole step after the fill, the step a taker holds; what is right of it is what a taker can still trade.

Pairs: ETHUSDT_PERP over BTCUSDT_PERP, pairs_z35_eth_btc_exit0 (trial 45), the pairs strategy with the best validation Sharpe; it was not released

Fitted on the trailing 1h before each 15m clock window and held through it; bands at z 3.5 in and 0 out, from the strategy's own bl.pairs call.

The spread is the log mid of A less the hedge ratio times that of B, here less its walk-forward mean, in bps. Its level jumps at every refit, so the mean is taken off. The dashed lines are where the strategy goes in, the dotted ones where it comes out, and the shading is where it held the spread.

The hedge ratio, the units of B the spread holds against one of A, fitted on the window before each clock window. A ratio that wanders makes the B leg trade at every refit.

How fast the spread came back inside each clock window: the half-life of an AR(1) fit. An open circle is a window where it did not come back at all. The dashed line is what the same fit reads on a pure random walk in a window this long, since the fitted slope sits below 1 even with no reversion: only points well under it show the spread coming back.

In the markout fan of the spread, every time its z-score went past the entry band of ±3.5 counts as a trade back toward the mean: short the spread when z is high, long when it is low. Events are at least 70 s apart. The line is the average move of the spread in that direction, at the hedge ratio of the moment, with two standard errors either side. A spread that reverts rises after zero. Breaking even takes crossing the spread of both legs twice, the B leg scaled by the hedge ratio, and the fees of both on top.

NOTES.md
# NOTES
- S1 directional: all 3 accepted. micro_dev_xrp (ewm4 microprice-mid bps, XRP) train rankIC10s .106, RELEASED (best .1). eth_book_imb (ewm4 imbalance ETH) .080 not released; flow_imb_xrp (10s trade imbalance) .039 not released.
- Book-lean features beat trade-flow ones. Untried: same microprice lean for BTC/ETH/SOL, deeper smoothing, lean x spread scaling, trade flow in other symbols.
- Shell loops are refused; one `blinded submit` per call. Write files with Write tool.
- S2 lead_lag: 3 accepted. ll_eth_lean_for_xrp (ewm4 ETH microprice lean -> XRP) train rankIC10s .078, RELEASED (best .06). ll_gap_avg_xrp_10s (mean BTC/ETH 10s gap over XRP, bps) .059, RELEASED (best .03). ll_gap_eth_sol_5s (lead_gap_z ETH->SOL 5s) ~0 (-.006), not released.
- Lead-lag price gaps are weak (DATA: C after fill ~.07-.11); leader BOOK lean beats gap. XRP is better follower than SOL. Untried: BTC lean->XRP/SOL, ETH lean->SOL, lean minus follower lean, gap at 1-2s, lagged_corr-weighted gap.
- S3 pairs: 3 accepted. pairs_lean_diff_eth_btc (ewm4 microprice-lean A minus B, bps) train rankIC10s .078, RELEASED (best .1). pairs_lean_diff_xrp_sol .071 not released. pairs_eth_btc_revert (-spread_z 2h/30m) weak: .040 10s, .063 60s (slow reversion, low turnover).
- Pairs: relative book lean beats spread z-score at short horizons; z-score only shows at 60s. Untried: -spread_z for XRP/SOL, shorter-window z, lean diff with deeper/shallower ewm, imbalance diff, trade-flow diff, z + lean combo.
- S4 pairs: 3 accepted. pairs_imb_diff_eth_btc (ewm4 imbalance diff ETH-BTC) rankIC10s .085, RELEASED (best .11). pairs_lean_diff_xrp_sol_slow (ewm20 lean diff) .036 and pairs_revert_xrp_sol_30m (-spread_z 30m/5m) .026 at 10s (.029 at 60s), neither released.
- Pairs: book-imbalance diff works for ETH/BTC; XRP/SOL is weak everywhere (slower smoothing and z-score both worse than ewm4 lean diff .071). Untried: imbalance diff XRP/SOL, ewm2 lean diff, lean+imb combo, trade-flow diff, lean diff scaled by spread.
- S5 directional: 3 accepted. btc_book_imb_fast (ewm2 imbalance BTC) rankIC10s .121 / 1s .285, RELEASED (best .16). micro_dev_eth (ewm4 lean ETH) .080 not released. xrp_imb_lean_combo (z-summed imb+lean XRP) .105 not released.
- BTC is the best directional target; faster smoothing (ewm2) beats ewm4 on imbalance. Lean ~ imbalance for ETH (no gain). Untried: BTC ewm1/raw imbalance, BTC lean, SOL imbalance, imbalance x spread_ticks, trade flow BTC.
- S6 lead_lag: 3 accepted. ll_btc_imb_for_xrp (ewm2 BTC imbalance -> XRP) rankIC10s .098 / 1s .114, RELEASED (best .09). ll_lead_imb_avg_for_xrp (ewm2 of BTC+ETH imbalance sum -> XRP) .110 10s / .140 1s, not released (best .09; odd, higher train IC). ll_eth_imb_for_sol (ewm2 ETH imb -> SOL) .040 10s, not released.
- Leader book imbalance > lean > price gap for lead_lag; XRP follows better than SOL. Untried: BTC imb->SOL, imbalance x lagged_corr, ewm1 imbalance, leader trade flow -> XRP, imbalance minus follower imbalance.
- S7 pairs: 3 accepted. pairs_imb_diff_eth_btc_fast (ewm2 imbalance diff ETH-BTC) rankIC10s .113 / 1s .185, RELEASED (best .14). pairs_imb_lean_eth_btc (imb+lean ewm2 combo, my scaling made it ~identical to imb alone: .113) not released. pairs_imb_diff_xrp_sol (ewm2 imb diff) .076 10s / .129 1s, not released (XRP/SOL still weaker; imb diff > lean diff .071).
- Faster smoothing helps pairs imbalance too. Untried: ewm1/raw imb diff, imb diff XRP/SOL ewm1, trade-flow diff, imb diff x spread, depth-weighted diff.
- S8 directional: 3 accepted. btc_imb_ewm1 (ewm1 BTC imbalance) rankIC10s .137 / 1s .328, RELEASED (best .175). xrp_imb_fast (ewm2 XRP imb) .127 10s, not released. sol_imb_fast (ewm2 SOL imb) .071 10s, not released.
- Less smoothing keeps helping BTC (ewm4 -> ewm2 -> ewm1). Untried: raw (no smoothing) BTC imbalance, BTC imb x spread_ticks, BTC trade flow, ETH ewm1 imbalance, XRP ewm1. SOL weakest target.
- S9 lead_lag: 3 accepted. ll_btc_imb_ewm1_for_xrp (ewm1 BTC imb -> XRP) rankIC10s .102 / 1s .128, RELEASED (best .095); ewm1 not better than ewm2 (.098) on train. ll_btc_imb_minus_xrp_imb (ewm1 BTC imb less XRP imb) ~.015, not released: subtracting follower's own imbalance kills the signal (XRP's own book carries the predictive part). ll_btc_imb_for_sol (ewm1) .054 10s / .092 1s, not released.
- Lead_lag saturating around .10 on XRP; SOL weak. Untried: leader trade flow -> XRP, imbalance x lagged_corr, ETH ewm1 -> XRP, imbalance sum (BTC+ETH) ewm1.
- S10 pairs: 3 accepted. pairs_imb_diff_eth_btc_ewm1 (ewm1 imb diff ETH-BTC) rankIC10s .135 / 1s .218, RELEASED (best .16). pairs_imb_diff_xrp_sol_ewm1 .085 10s / .157 1s, not released (XRP/SOL still weaker). pairs_flow_diff_eth_btc (5s trade-imbalance diff) -.038 10s, not released: trade flow diff is useless/slightly negative.
- Pairs imb diff keeps improving with less smoothing (ewm4 .085 -> ewm2 .113 -> ewm1 .135). Untried: raw (no smoothing) imb diff, imb diff x spread_ticks, depth-weighted diff, sign-flipped flow (reversal) at longer windows.
- S11 directional: 3 accepted. btc_imb_raw (unsmoothed BTC imbalance) rankIC10s .148 / 1s .365, RELEASED (best .185). xrp_imb_ewm1 .143 10s, not released (best .185). btc_eth_imb_for_btc (BTC+.5 ETH imb ewm1) .137 10s, not released: adding ETH dilutes BTC's own imbalance.
- Raw beats ewm1 for BTC (.137 -> .148); smoothing hurts. XRP also improves with less smoothing (ewm2 .127 -> ewm1 .143). Untried: raw XRP/ETH/SOL imbalance, imbalance x spread_ticks, depth-weighted imbalance, BTC trade flow. Little left on BTC imbalance itself.
- S12 lead_lag: 3 accepted. ll_lead_imb_sum_raw_for_xrp (raw BTC+ETH imbalance sum -> XRP) rankIC10s .113 / 1s .167, RELEASED (best .105). ll_eth_imb_raw_for_xrp (raw ETH imb) .092 10s, not released. ll_lead_imb_sum_raw_for_sol .062 10s / 1s .136, not released (SOL still weak).
- Raw (unsmoothed) leader imbalance sum is the best lead_lag so far; summing both leaders > either alone. Untried: leader trade flow -> XRP, imbalance x lagged_corr, sum weighted by spread, ETH ewm1 -> XRP.
- S13 directional STRATEGIES (first): btc_imb_thresh (threshold z1.6/0.8 on btc_imb_ewm1) train net SR -4.8 (gross +102 bps/h, 0.46 bps/fill vs 1 bp fee), trial 37; xrp_imb_thresh (xrp_imb_ewm1, 1.6/0.8) SR -7.3 (gross negative at 10s hold), trial 38. Neither released.
- Taker fee 1bp/fill kills 500ms book-imbalance signals: gross/fill ~0.45bp. bl.linear on BTC: SR -6.7 (1289 bps/h turnover). Imbalance is bounded so z_in>=1.8 never trades (1.5 ok). Need a signal with >1bp edge per fill: slower/rarer entries (longer hold, e.g. 60s-horizon features), spread-aware gating, or combine imb with large-move filter. Local eval: `blinded eval strategies/x.py --brief brief.yaml --window train`; no shell loops.
- S14 lead_lag STRATEGIES (first): all accepted, none released, all net negative on train. ll_imb_sum_flip_xrp (ewm hl10 of raw BTC+ETH imb sum, threshold z1.0/0.0) SR -1.97, gross -0.20bp/fill, trial 39; ll_imb_sum_hold_xrp (hl2, z1.5/0.0) -2.49, trial 40; ll_gap_thresh_xrp (10s gap avg, z2/0.5) -2.89, gross -0.52bp/fill, trial 41.
- Even with fees 0 gross is NEGATIVE for lead_lag thresholds on XRP (taker fills 100ms after decision cross the spread; spread cost ~0.8bp/fill dominates the signal). Lower turnover helped (smoother = less negative). Maker proxy is positive (+1.2bp/fill) but isn't scored. Untried: much slower signals (60s-horizon, hl 60+), z_in only at extremes, gating on tight spread, conditioning entries on leader move size.
- S15 pairs STRATEGIES (first): bl.pairs z-score is the only positive one. pairs_z_eth_btc_wide (z3.0/0.5, 1h/15m) train SR +0.32, 259 fills, +1.07bp/fill net, trial 42, not released. pairs_z_xrp_sol_wide (same) SR +0.11, trial 43, not released. pairs_imb_hold_eth_btc (imb diff ewm1 -> ewm hl60, threshold 1.2/0, legs +1/-1) SR -0.88, gross 0.11bp/fill vs 1bp fee; hl10 version SR -5.6. Imbalance-diff signals cannot pay taker fees at any hold tried.
- Pairs strategies: wide z-score entries (rare, ~6 fills/h, gross ~1.9bp/fill) are net positive; fast book signals are not. Untried: z_in 3.5-4, longer window 4h, z_out 0 / 1.0, gating imb-diff entries by z extremes (z beyond 2 AND imbalance agreeing), vol-scaled sizing.
- S16 pairs STRATEGIES: all accepted, none released (best none yet), all positive on train. pairs_z3_eth_btc_4h (z3/0.5, 4h/30m) SR +0.44, 133 fills, +2.77bp/fill net, trial 47 (best so far). pairs_z35_eth_btc_exit0 (z3.5/0, 1h/15m) SR +0.34, 147 fills, trial 45. pairs_z3_xrp_sol_2h_exit1 (z3/1.0, 2h/30m) SR +0.17, trial 46.
- Longer fit window (4h) beat 1h for ETH/BTC (SR .32 -> .44, lower drawdown). XRP/SOL still weaker (spread 47bp?, gross 1.7bp/fill). Untried: ETH/BTC 6-8h window, z_in 2.5 w/ 4h, z_out 0 w/ 4h, XRP/SOL 4h window.
- S17 directional STRATEGIES: 3 accepted, none released. xrp_stretch_follow (XRP mid minus ewm1200 in bps, momentum, threshold z2/0.5) train SR +0.05, 54 fills, +1.17bp/fill net, trial 48 (only positive; the reversion sign was -8bp/fill on 28 fills). btc_imb_slow60 (raw BTC imb ewm hl120, z1.6/0.5) SR -0.15, 466 fills, gross 0.67bp/fill, trial 49. btc_imb_slow30 (hl60, z1.5/0.3) SR -0.44, trial 50. hl240 z1.2/0 gross -2.2bp/fill (too slow, SR -0.24).
- Slower smoothing of BTC imbalance raises gross/fill (0.46 -> 0.51 -> 0.67) but never reaches the 1bp fee; the hl240 version loses the signal. Price-momentum stretch on XRP is positive but tiny. Untried: BTC/ETH momentum stretch, imbalance gated by stretch agreement, hl120 with z_out 0.8 (fewer fills), vol-scaled stretch threshold.
- Shell: multi-command bash with heredocs got refused; use Write tool and one command per call.
- S18 lead_lag STRATEGIES: 2 accepted, none released, both negative. ll_imb_sum_wide_xrp (raw BTC+ETH imb sum ewm hl120, z1.5/0.8) SR -0.51, 558 fills, gross +0.19bp/fill, trial 51 (best lead_lag so far). ll_gap_extreme_xrp (10s gap avg ewm hl10, z3/1) SR -1.02, gross -0.55bp/fill, trial 52. Price-gap signal is dead for taker; slower imb sum is the only direction improving. Untried: hl240+ with z_out 1.0, gating on leader move size or spread, SOL as follower is weaker.
- S19 pairs STRATEGIES: 3 accepted, none released, all positive on train. pairs_z3_eth_btc_8h (z3/0.5, 8h/30m) SR +0.36, 76 fills, +3.2bp/fill net, trial 53 (not better than 4h .44). pairs_z3_xrp_sol_4h SR +0.24, 78 fills, +2.3bp/fill, trial 54 (4h beats 2h .17 for XRP/SOL). pairs_z25_eth_btc_4h_exit0 (z2.5/0) SR +0.29, 88 fills, +4.3bp/fill but drawdown 193bp, trial 55.
- ETH/BTC window sweet spot ~4h (1h .32, 4h .44, 8h .36); longer window helps XRP/SOL too. Only ~36h of train, so SR differences are noisy (18-20 round trips). Untried: XRP/SOL 8h, z_in 3.5 w/ 4h, vol-scaled sizing, both pairs combined.

# DATA: binance-um-btc-eth-sol-xrp-2024-03-27-3d-500ms-fee1

File `train.parquet`, sha256 `ccc5a37ff1e65489`.
Clock: exchange. Grid: 500ms steps, 259,201 points, 2024-03-27 00:00:00+00:00 to 2024-03-28 12:00:00+00:00; warm-up 5min.

Scoring windows (warm-up removed):
- train [2024-03-27T00:05:00+00:00, 2024-03-28T12:00:00+00:00)
- val [2024-03-28T12:05:00+00:00, 2024-03-29T06:00:00+00:00)
- test [2024-03-29T06:05:00+00:00, 2024-03-30T00:00:00.500000+00:00)

## A thinned file

For every grid point g this file keeps the last book row at or before each of the stamps g - 50 ms, g, g + 50 ms, and drops the rest; the judge reads the book only there, so the panel, the fills and every forward return are what the raw file would give. Each kept book row carries `n`, the raw updates it stands for, so `cum_book` counts them all. Trades are summed per side between the panel's reads: one row per side and step at the stamp of that side's last trade, `qty` the side's total, `price` its volume-weighted price and `n` its number of trades. Volumes, notionals, trade counts and the side of the last trade are exact at every grid point; `price` and `qty` of the last trade are the step's per-side VWAP and total, not one print.

Reads at other stamps would see the kept row before them, so the judge leaves out the horizons and offsets the file cannot serve: decay horizons under one step that do not end on a kept stamp, and markout offsets likewise. Lead-lag inside one step is in the raw-file section, where it was measured before thinning.

## Streams

Gaps are between distinct timestamps; `stale_share` is the share of grid points whose latest event is older than one grid step. On this thinned file they describe the kept rows, not the market.

| stream | instrument | rows | duplicate_rows | events_per_s | median_gap_ms | p90_gap_ms | stale_share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| book | BTCUSDT_PERP | 675,866 | 0 | 5.215 | 85 | 412 | 0.0003164 |
| book | ETHUSDT_PERP | 674,382 | 0 | 5.204 | 87 | 411 | 0.000216 |
| book | SOLUSDT_PERP | 580,071 | 0 | 4.476 | 156 | 436 | 0.005841 |
| book | XRPUSDT_PERP | 608,752 | 0 | 4.697 | 113 | 433 | 0.002377 |
| trades | BTCUSDT_PERP | 425,124 | 1,992 | 3.265 | 285 | 573 | 0.04706 |
| trades | ETHUSDT_PERP | 355,397 | 4,954 | 2.704 | 325 | 712 | 0.1236 |
| trades | SOLUSDT_PERP | 283,802 | 406 | 2.187 | 368 | 933 | 0.2363 |
| trades | XRPUSDT_PERP | 205,227 | 784 | 1.577 | 464 | 1337 | 0.389 |

The cross-stream lags and trade stamps of the raw file are in the raw-file section at the end; on the kept rows they would measure the thinning.

## Lead-lag on train

C(tau) is the correlation of the leader's last 500 ms log return at each grid point with the follower's 500 ms return ending tau later, over whole steps from -10 to +10. A follower that copies with a delay peaks at that delay. `c_after_fill` is C on the follower's first whole step after a taker's fill (100 ms after the decision, so tau = 600 ms), the step a taker holds; `best_after_fill` the largest C from there on; `usable_by_taker` says yes when that is positive and at least half the peak, a rule of thumb.

| leader | follower | lag_at_peak_ms | c_at_peak | c_after_fill | best_after_fill | usable_by_taker |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BTCUSDT_PERP | SOLUSDT_PERP | 0 | 0.5292 | 0.06596 | 0.06596 | no |
| BTCUSDT_PERP | XRPUSDT_PERP | 0 | 0.417 | 0.1043 | 0.1043 | no |
| ETHUSDT_PERP | SOLUSDT_PERP | 0 | 0.5515 | 0.06665 | 0.06665 | no |
| ETHUSDT_PERP | XRPUSDT_PERP | 0 | 0.4358 | 0.1103 | 0.1103 | no |

## Pairs on train

Each pair A over B fitted as `bl.pairs` fits it at the brief's defaults: OLS of ln m_A on ln m_B over the trailing 2h, refitted at each 30m clock window. `hedge_ratio` and `residual_sd_bps` are the fit in force at the end of train; `median_half_life_s` is the AR(1) half-life of the spread in each clock window, the median over windows (none when most did not revert), and `no_reversion` the share of windows where it did not come back at all. A pairs feature is scored against the spread return at equal notional, A's forward log return less B's.

| pair | hedge_ratio | residual_sd_bps | median_half_life_s | no_reversion | windows |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ETHUSDT_PERP over BTCUSDT_PERP | 0.5994 | 7.02 | 115.8 | 0 | 71 |
| XRPUSDT_PERP over SOLUSDT_PERP | 0.5915 | 13.05 | 147.7 | 0.04225 | 71 |

## Caveats

- Rows with identical timestamps resolve by file order, last wins.
- Which instruments are in the file, and why, is for the user to own.
- Exchange clock: the brief assumes each row reaches you 50 ms after its stamp (overrides aside), so a decision at g sees stamps up to g less that delay, and an order's latency runs from g.

## Splits

- train: 2024-03-27T00:00:00+00:00 to 2024-03-28T12:00:00+00:00; this workspace holds these 3,808,621 rows (sha256 `ccc5a37ff1e65489`)
- validation: 2024-03-28T12:05:00+00:00 to 2024-03-29T06:00:00+00:00; in the vault, scored through the Ladder only
- test: 2024-03-29T06:05:00+00:00 to 2024-03-30T00:00:00.500000+00:00; in the vault, scored once at the end
- embargo of 5min before validation and before test

## The raw files behind binance-um-btc-eth-sol-xrp-2024-03-27-3d-500ms.parquet

Built by `blinded demo binance` from data.binance.vision: USD-M perpetuals BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, 3 days from 2024-03-27, top of book (`bookTicker`) and trades. Stamps are the exchange's: `transaction_time` for the book and `time` for trades, the matching engine's clock in ms; `event_time`, when the message left, is not used. Each zip matched its `.CHECKSUM` (SHA-256 below).

The brief's latency is 50 ms of order and 50 ms of feed: a decision at g sees stamps up to g - 50 ms and its order fills at stamp g + 50 ms. The file keeps, for every grid point g of the 500ms grid, the last book row at or before g - 50 ms, g, g + 50 ms, with `n` the raw rows each stands for, and the trades summed per side between the panel's reads.

Thinning identity, on the first hour of BTCUSDT_PERP: a panel from the 695,257 raw rows and one from the 30,135 kept rows agree at all 7,199 grid points in 15 columns (all but the last trade's price and size), and the bid and ask agree at all 28,796 fill reads, at the brief's latency and at zero.

Checks on each symbol-day: stamps never go backwards; the book is not batched (median gap between distinct stamps under 50 ms, no 10 ms bin from 20 to 1000 ms holding over 20% of gaps) and neither are the trades (the bin test only: trades are sparse); trades print at the touch of the book best within 5 ms of their stamp (`touch`, on up to 200,000 trades spread over the day); and the mid and the trade price move together within 5 ms (`mid_vs_trade`, 100 ms returns searched over +-500 ms).
